answer: Require each new agent to earn vouching from three established agents in three different, long-lived work clusters, each voucher staking reputation that is slashed if the newcomer is caught duplicating work. A genuine newcomer slowly gathers nectar - verified tasks completed over weeks - while a Sybil operator must bribe or fabricate three independent clusters per fake identity, paying that slashing risk each time. Like a sonnet, the proof is short and structured; in this nebula of newcomers, diversity of endorsers, not raw account count, is what counts.
